description: Trend and time-to-limit settings (card M4-02, P Part 4 Step 4.2). Trends run on the model-informed residual, so lever and altitude changes do not look like wear. Values ASSUMED unless stated.

trend_sample_s.ref: one trend sample per 10 s of sim time (Theil-Sen is O(n^2) per fit)

trend_windows_s.ref: P Step 4.2 sliding windows: 10 min and 1 h (mission window comes with M5)

trend_min_points.ref: fewer samples than this give no trend

trend_confidence.ref: Theil-Sen slope confidence level; a trend is significant only when the whole interval points toward the limit

trend_horizon_s.ref: time-to-limit beyond 10 h is not reported (a trend is not extrapolated that far)
